mo_ta_cong_viec:
The opportunity
At ANDPAD Vietnam, we are building AI-driven web and mobile applications to transform the construction industry. We are looking for a Software Development Engineer in Test who is passionate about quality and has a strong engineering mindset to help us scale our product with confidence.
In this role, you will act as a key individual contributor, owning test strategy and driving quality improvements across the product team. You will work closely with AI projects to ensure high-quality releases with fast delivery.
 
Job Scope
Design, build, and maintain automation test frameworks for Web, Mobile and API (using tools such as Playwright, Cypress, or similar)
Collaborate with Product and AI teams to define quality metrics for AI-driven features
Participate in upstream processes to execute testing efficiently and identify risks early.
Ensure high test coverage across UI, API, and system levels
Formulate test strategies and plans to ensure quality and delivery speed at the team level.
Drive SDLC process improvement and "Shift-Left" initiatives based on bug trend and root cause analysis.
Mentor others and support their professional growth through knowledge sharing.
Note: This is a highly technical role focused on engineering and automation, not manual testing.
 
Development environment
Backend: Ruby (on Rails), Go, Amazon Aurora(MySQL), Elasticsearch, DynamoDB
FrontEnd: ReactJS, VueJS, NuxtJS, NextJS
Mobile App: Kotlin, Swift, Flutter
Deploy/ Build: CodePipeline, CodeBuild, CircleCI, GitHub Actions
Automation test: Autify, Magicpod
Others: swagger, Docker,  Figma, Confluence, JIRA, esa
yeu_cau:
Must-have:
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field
3+ years of experience as a Software Engineer and 4+ years in Test (SDET) or Automation Engineer, specializing in Web, Mobile applications and API
Strong coding skills in modern programming languages (such as Go, RoR, Python, JavaScript/Typescript) with a proven track record of designing test automation frameworks
Strong command of English, both written and verbal, with the ability to collaborate effectively with Developers and Product Managers
Preferred: 
Experience leading or mentoring a small QA team
Experience in test management within a product team or Agile/Scrum team environment
Experience in development projects for Japanese companies
Knowledge of business flows in the Architecture/Construction industry
Experience in non-functional testing (Security, Performance, Scalability)
Continuous Learning Mindset: A self-driven learner who continuously explores and adopts new technologies and methodologies to stay updated
